product_metadata.title: PrepSolutions Compact Microwave Multi-Mat, 9.5 Inches, Gray
features: MULTIFUNCTIONAL MAT: Protect your hands when lifting hot dishes with this mat designed for compact microwaves. It can also be used as a splatter guard, jar opener, hot pad, trivet or utensil rest!
DISHWASHER & MICROWAVE SAFE: This silicone mat is dishwasher & microwave safe. It measures 9.5" in diameter and it's the perfect multifunction tool for your kitchen. Also works great as a drying mat!
FOOD PREP MADE EASY: We offer kitchen accessories that make food preparation faster, easier & more enjoyable, from fruit & veggie choppers to measuring spoons & cups & collapsible storage bowls.

STYLISH DESIGN & SOLID FUNCTIONALITY: Our philosophy is simple—offer stylish designs with no-nonsense functionality. We understand the kitchen is the heart of the home, where family & friends connect.
INNOVATING KITCHEN ESSENTIALS: We boast over 40 years of innovating kitchen products & housewares with unique gadgets & tools for food preparation plus thoughtfully designed food storage containers.
description: Used as: microwave Mat, splatter guard, jar opener, hot pad, trivet & utensil rest. For compact microwaves. Protects hands when lifting hot dishes. 9. 5" (24 cm) diameter. Bpa-free.
